t: 霍尔米日德四世是萨珊帝国的国王,被他的同父兄弟维斯塔姆和文杜伊赫所推翻并蒙蔽了双眼.
te: Hormizd IV, king of the Sasanian Empire, is overthrown and blinded by his brothers-in-law Vistahm and Vinduyih.
dz: 霍尔米日德四世是萨珊帝国的国王,被他的同父兄弟维斯塔姆和文杜伊赫所推翻并蒙蔽了双眼.
de: Hormizd IV, king of the Sasanian Empire, is overthrown and blinded by his brothers-in-law Vistahm and Vinduyih.

t: 霍斯劳二世被加冕为波斯国王.
te: Khosrau II is crowned king of Persia.
dz: 霍斯劳二世被加冕为波斯国王.
de: Khosrau II is crowned king of Persia.

t: 莫里斯皇帝宣布他的儿子西奥多修斯为拜占庭帝国的共主.
te: Emperor Maurice proclaims his son Theodosius as co-emperor of the Byzantine Empire.
dz: 莫里斯皇帝宣布他的儿子西奥多修斯为拜占庭帝国的共主.
de: Emperor Maurice proclaims his son Theodosius as co-emperor of the Byzantine Empire.

t: 教宗格雷戈里一世(大主教)的封号.
te: Consecration of Pope Gregory I (Gregory the Great).
dz: 教宗格雷戈里一世(大主教)的封号.
de: Consecration of Pope Gregory I (Gregory the Great).
